title: Pool a100-pool runs 2 NVIDIA driver versions

fix.summary: Align pool a100-pool's node image so every node runs one driver: upgrade or recreate the older nodes (GKE: the pool's gpu-driver-version; EKS: the AMI release; self-managed: the driver install). Mixed drivers make NCCL and CUDA behaviour differ by node.

title: Image Streaming is off on GPU pool a100-pool
evidence: pool a100-pool: gke-gpu-a100-pool-1, gke-gpu-a100-pool-2 without cloud.google.com/gke-image-streaming=true

fix.summary: Enable Image Streaming on node pool a100-pool, so accelerator pods start before their Artifact Registry image is fully pulled.

title: 1 accelerator Job skips Kueue's quota
evidence: Job/research/eval-adhoc: 2 × nvidia.com/gpu per pod, no kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name label

fix.summary: Add the label kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name: <LocalQueue> to each Job. (Unless Kueue's manageJobsWithoutQueueName is on, which discovery cannot read.)

title: 1 inference server scales on the wrong signal

fix.summary: Scale on queue depth, not CPU: a KEDA ScaledObject with a Prometheus trigger on vllm:num_requests_waiting (or KV-cache usage; Triton: nv_inference_queue_duration_us).

title: 1 workload downloads its model on every pod start
evidence: Deployment/llm/llama-predictor: storage-initializer fetches gs://acme-models/llama-3.1-8b-instruct on every start

fix.summary: Ship the weights by digest as an OCI artifact the node pulls once (an image volume or a KServe modelcar), or cache them on the nodes with KServe LocalModelCache.

title: 2 workloads run accelerators with the 64 MiB /dev/shm default
evidence: Deployment/llm/llama-predictor: 2 pods, container kserve-container mounts no memory emptyDir at /dev/shm
Job/research/eval-adhoc: 1 pod, container eval mounts no memory emptyDir at /dev/shm

fix.summary: Mount an emptyDir {medium: Memory} (with a sizeLimit) at /dev/shm in each accelerator container: NCCL, PyTorch DataLoader workers and vLLM's tensor parallelism need more than 64 MiB.

title: 1 accelerator image is not warm on every node of its pool
evidence: us-docker.pkg.dev/acme-ml/research/finetune:2026-11-20: not on gke-gpu-a100-pool-2 (pool a100-pool; present on 1 of 2 nodes)
node.status.images lists at most 50 images per node by default, so a busy node may hold an image it does not list

fix.summary: Pre-pull the image on the pool (a pre-pull DaemonSet, kube-fledged), or bake it into the node image (GKE: a secondary boot disk), so a new pod does not wait for the pull.

title: Image volumes are unavailable: weights cannot be mounted from an OCI artifact without a sidecar
evidence: API server v1.31.4-gke.1256000: the ImageVolume feature gate is on by default from Kubernetes 1.35

fix.summary: Upgrade to Kubernetes 1.35+ with containerd 2.1+ to mount weights as an image volume. Until then, KServe's modelcar sidecar or an init-container copy is the fallback.
